scope: Catalog-defined six packages across three generated hosts, additive correctness only, exact existing supported workflow scope retained.

criteria.note: Current catalog-derived obligations and independent review cover every public/private owner. Adopt the 19 reviewed LEX correctness adaptations and independently assessed unchanged Help/Cleanup owners; preserve all baseline identities and previous decisions. Structural missing/duplicate/owner controls remain unchanged.

Dedicated Skill Write and Deploy Prompt identities remain distinct; corrected G1–G6 qualify exact generation/readiness/recovery stimuli without execution. Existing source-bound frontend/video prompt-only observations and requested-output constraints are retained within their original limits.

Help/Handoff exact host routes and availability contracts are independently source-reviewed; unchanged historical H1–H5 observations and route controls are retained with their raw-context caveat. Corrected B2 independently demonstrates the missing-selected-skill stop. No automatic root execution or installation is accepted.

Independent source assessment and corrected Build/review boundary cases preserve one-root/helper authority, read-only review, configured controls and no helper-driven tracker/comment/production effects. Response-only proposals do not prove actual product operations.

Debug additions retain causal diagnosis, redaction, original failure and regression checks. Corrected L5 distinguishes expected TDD RED from disproved repair premises; unchanged synthetic-auth and causal repair evidence remain scoped observations, not universal model safety.

Consumed prerequisite and graph readiness rules retain actual artifact dependencies, cycle refusal, bounded briefs, known-bad oracle controls and integration exceptions. Corrected L1/L2/L4 and current source assessment qualify changed execution/decomposition guidance.

Advanced evidence rules retain immutable revision/sample/order identity, append-only corrections, product failures and contradictions. Corrected L11/B7 and independent source review qualify changed reduction/measurement guidance; cleanup and unaffected historical controls remain intact.

Retain the reporting/compression baseline. Correctness-only guidance is qualified through named corrected-transport cases and prior zero-dollar cases, not a completed matched full comparison. Original E4 remains unqualified; independently accepted E4-AM1 adds the exact omitted predecessor only. Original B8/MR failures remain failed. No universal reliability or blanket isolation claim.

Retain the efficiency baseline. The frozen 294-run comparison remains unexecuted; full attributable usage and loaded-instruction measurement remain unavailable. No savings, compression, automatic model routing or efficiency-only adoption is accepted.

Frontend reference/brand/responsiveness/accessibility and prompt/image-only boundaries remain unchanged. Independent source assessment, corrected selective-repair case L7 and already qualified MT1–MT3 support exact named scope; shared inputs reopen affected coverage. No actual new image/product execution or general reliability is inferred.

The independent visual-parity root, immutable baselines, fixed tolerance/environment/state coverage and sensitive negative controls are unchanged from the accepted baseline. Current projections preserve them; this release does not claim fresh pixel parity for arbitrary products.

All twelve advanced outcomes and private capabilities retain separate identities and closure. Independent source assessment and corrected L11/L12/B7 qualify the additive scoped evidence and measurement discipline. Live/artifact and create/maintain authority remain distinct.

Original identities, source revisions, original/derived hashes, notices and many-to-one mappings remain intact. New current source and closure decisions are supported independently; exact pre-release provenance/audit and all previous chains retain historical pending/unknown states. No digest refresh alone is adoption.

Selection/install code and catalogs are unchanged from the published 4.4.6 baseline. Core-only fresh selection, saved choices, explicit optionals and old capability preservation retain their existing fault controls. Native discovery uses disposable test homes; no user-host install/update is accepted.

Actual isolated Codex skills/list and Pi get_commands expose exact current catalog roots with private helpers absent; source/cache file bytes and executable bits match. Existing unchanged Claude transient loader debug proves all 39 source roots. Full tree equality is not claimed for eight normalized cache directories. Native discovery is separate from routing and actual user-host activation.

Ownership/dirty/foreign/path/symlink/hash protection implementations are unchanged. Existing isolated fault and unrelated-state preservation controls remain applicable. New probes preserve all 164 sampled actual-user control records; this is not an actual user-host withdrawal/migration acceptance.

Unchanged retry/rollback transaction machinery retains fault injection, convergence and honest residual-state reporting. No rollback was executed on user hosts. Required local checks still gate the candidate; no failed or partial operation is relabeled successful.

All 21 video modules, original source mappings, indexed resources and imports remain intact. Three relocated host projections pass closure verification and real local SFX resolution; removal of a required linked resource fails. Source closure adoption retains the already documented bounded workflow scope.

Retain exactly the previously accepted Linux CLI/core0.8.77 local caption/cut/zoom/crossfade/grouped-carve/subcomposition/portrait and supplied-caption scope. Six fresh exact-profile cases verify encoded frames/audio and repeated seeks; unchanged historical supplied-caption resources/measurements remain independently bound. Other OS/provider/speech/matting dimensions are not newly qualified; required unavailable routes block their selected outcomes.

Scope/pins/providers/budgets and no route-driven external publication/report/install remain preserved. Corrected prompt/repair cases and unchanged historical controls support named boundaries. Runtime acquisition was separately authorized in /tmp; runtime freshness/font attempts were refused and recorded. No claim of transport silence; prohibited unpinned Kokoro remains prohibited.

Unchanged Unlazy engine/security scripts retain historical Linux Node16 floor/Node24 suite evidence; current three-host moved imports and 30 subprocess controls cover actual success, stale definitions, documented artifact-status limitation, parent reverify and abandonment. Hooks stay opt-in. Windows, detached containment and actual user-host hook adoption remain unverified.

Current root/lockfile and all active manifests agree on 4.4.7; canonical/Claude/Pi policy and Codex projector exception remain unchanged. Required sync/check/full regression and six strict Claude validations gate the final tracked candidate. Previous PS3.8.0 payload remains exact.

Generated current provenance documentation must reflect these separately evidenced source decisions while historical records remain exact. Current acceptance is explicitly scoped; publication, installed hosts and efficiency remain separate. Dormant sources and retained PS transition identity are unpromoted.

This is a new explicit current acceptance decision with catalog-derived obligations and source/evidence bindings, never an upgrade of old receipts. The production replacement validator must accept all six packages/three hosts from a tracked immutable candidate before Git/publication advances. Prior stable release, backups and rollout boundaries remain available.
